headline: Insta360’s next 360-degree action cam puts bigger sensors in a smaller design
summary: Insta360's new X6 action camera features a smaller design than previous models. It boasts improved video capabilities with larger custom 1/1.1-inch Sony sensors. This iteration expands Insta360's popular 360-degree camera offerings.

headline: Honor’s Robot Phone is better than a gimbal in a phone has any right to be
summary: Honor launched a new Android smartphone in China, dubbed the 'Robot Phone.' It uniquely integrates a compact gimbal arm for its main camera directly into the phone. The innovative design surprises with its performance, akin to a DJI Osmo Pocket.

headline: Of course the ChatGPT dog cancer vaccine spawned a startup
summary: An Australian entrepreneur used AI tools like ChatGPT to craft a personalized cancer vaccine for his dog. Paul Conyngham has now launched Gamgee, a startup offering personalized mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. This venture aims to commercialize the AI-assisted veterinary innovation.

headline: Grok is now an AI ‘teammate’ you can assign work
summary: SpaceXAI introduced Grok Bot, an AI agent service designed as 'AI teammates.' These bots operate in their own cloud environment, signing into apps and tools. They can autonomously complete multi-step workplace tasks, returning when done.

headline: Sony Predicts Influx of New Players as Helldivers 2 Drops on the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog Alongside New Update and Warhammer 40,000 Warbond
summary: Helldivers 2 has been surprise-added to the PlayStation Plus game catalog. The game's arrival coincides with a major new update. A highly anticipated Warhammer 40,000 crossover Warbond has also been released.

headline: The Voice of The Witcher's Geralt Says He'd Sue Every Single AI Platform With His Voice on It 'Into the Ground' if He Could
summary: Doug Cockle, Geralt's voice actor, strongly condemns AI platforms using his voice. He expressed a desire to sue such platforms 'into the ground' if legally possible. This highlights growing concerns among actors regarding AI voice synthesis.

headline: How Wet Hot American Summer Went from Box Office Bomb to Cult Classic
summary: Director David Wain reflects on 25 years of 'Wet Hot American Summer.' The film initially failed at the box office but gained cult classic status. Wain discusses the movie's origins and the possibility of future follow-ups.

headline: Space Marine 2 Maker Saber Interactive Denies Writer's Claim They Were Replaced by ChatGPT, but Admits Rideshare Stimulator Will Feature AI 'By Necessity'
summary: Saber Interactive denies replacing a writer for 'Space Marine 2' with ChatGPT. However, the company confirms AI use in its upcoming 'Rideshare Stimulator' game. AI in 'Rideshare Stimulator' is described as being used 'by necessity.'

headline: Three ways to watch the solar eclipse safely without glasses
summary: Many shops are out of stock for solar eclipse glasses. The article provides three safe methods to observe the eclipse using household items. These alternatives allow safe viewing for those without specialized glasses.

headline: Burnham says disposable BBQ ban under consideration
summary: The PM suggests avoiding single-use grills due to wildfire risks. A ban on disposable BBQs is currently under consideration. This measure aims to mitigate potential fire hazards.

headline: Jasper Carrott says family is 'so proud' of Lucy Davis after cancer diagnosis
summary: Actress Lucy Davis, known for 'The Office,' has revealed an incurable breast cancer diagnosis. Her father, Jasper Carrott, expressed immense family pride in her. The news highlights public support for the actress.

headline: Cambridge review into Jason Arday post will be independent, university says
summary: Cambridge University announces an independent review into Jason Arday's professorial appointment. Vice-chancellor Deborah Prentice acknowledged staff concerns regarding the appointment. The review aims to address questions surrounding the process.
